warning.title: ALWAYS HOT
lines: HD34 cavity J (ES_RX) and the receiver RED lead are live with the kit master switch OFF.
The feed comes from the enclosure safety chain, upstream of the master relay.

footer: No solder anywhere: every conductor ends in a size-16 crimp pin pushed into the receptacle rear · the seven unused cavities take 114017 sealing plugs · beacon cord enters through the gland uncut
